principle_violations.reason: The Shape interface forces every implementing class to define both area and volume methods, even if the class cannot logically provide an implementation for one of them.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate area-related and volume-related behavior into distinct interfaces, for instance, AreaCalculable and VolumeCalculable, and use them selectively based on the classes' capabilities.
